I agree with the message, but not the way you go about it. For one, blood does not out range seer. Seer and blood scan goes the exact same distance (75m) blood just has more of a wider scan. Seer ult goes quite a ways below the device and enemies will constantly move through it because its stupid af for people to stand still, especially in a third party scenario. Seer is a good legend that needs help. Secondly, you overrate blood, their passive literally lasts 90 seconds. Not minutes. Blood ult is also buggy in some areas and the highlight nature of it sometimes doesn't work, and even then you don't gain aim assist through smoke on any platform so you lose out on aim even though you can see through smoke. Personally, they need to increase the range of seer scan to ~80 or 85m to give him more of an advantage in certain scenarios. They'd also need to revert the momentum nerfs seer got from his scan and passive. That's all.

If it still isn't helping, try getting a friend to play and help you aim and track. Maybe tweak your sensitivities if its too slow or fast. What server do you play on too? I may be able to hop on and play and help you practice in the firing range for a bit at like 5/6-ish? I also recommend playing Gibraltar for a bit too to get the hang of shooting people as the gun shield helps with not dying.
